role: diagnostic fixed-vs-variable tariff bridge plus matched causal policy benchmark

paired_daily_cash_difference_adaptive_mi.interpretation: interpret the paired weekly-block bootstrap interval by sign: entirely positive means adaptive is more expensive; entirely negative means adaptive is cheaper; crossing zero means no robust cash dominance
paired_daily_cash_difference_adaptive_mi.conclusion: price-adaptive policy is slightly but robustly more expensive than matched C0 over the formal period; do not claim Q4-2 savings from price adaptation

claim_boundary: matched policy benchmark; unlike R0 it shares the Q4 state, physics and information process and changes only the decision tariff
